messages:
Maya: Hey everyone — quick all-hands reminder for tomorrow 10:00 PT. Agenda in brief: 1) Q1 operational highlights + incidents recap; 2) Product roadmap & Dedicated capacity launch timeline; 3) Policy update: data residency options; 4) Open Q&A. Please drop questions below or add them to the form: https://forms.gle/rdw-allhands-questions :sparkles:  

Ethan: Will there be a published timeline for the Dedicated rollout we can share with customers?

Maya: Yes — Grace will walk through the rollout plan and the guardrails (canary, SLA targets, region order). We'll post the timeline & talking points after the meeting.

Ravi: Heads-up—I can't make 10am PT (overlaps with customer sync APAC). Can someone record and post link?

ops-bot: Event created: All-hands — Q2 roadmap. Recording enabled. Calendar invite updated.

Nora: Added two items to agenda doc: 1) brief incident summary slide for last week's 15-min outage, 2) recommended customer messaging template for Dedicated opt-in.

Devon: Can we get a short explainer slide on how Routing/fallback works across Hosted/Dedicated/Private? Product teams keep getting this question.

Grace: Yep — I'll include a 2-slide explainer + quick demo of routing policies. Also plan to call out cost/perf tradeoffs and the Optimize recommendations we saw in the pilot.

Maya: Thanks — quick notes for folks who want to prep: - Bring 1 slide if your team needs a 60s update - Drop Qs in the form or here by EOD today - We'll keep Q&A to 20m, capture follow-ups in product threads

Ethan: Minor ask: can we mention the new internal policy for staging datasets (pii handling)? It's small but product teams need to be aware.

Maya: Yes — Policy change will be covered under item 3. Short summary: mandatory KMS for staging environments with PII, new approval workflow via security ticket. Full text will be posted to the handbook.

Ravi: Thanks — if the recording is posted, can we also get the TL;DR notes? Saves me time.

Grace: Will do: recording + 5-bullet TL;DR + links to slides and the rollout timeline. Expected to be in #all-hands within 2 hours after meeting.

Nora: FYI, I added the incident postmortem link to the agenda doc for context: https://internal.redwood/pm/pm-1723

Devon: :thumbsup: Thanks — sharing with customer success so they're aligned for the Dedicated outreach.

Maya: Final logistic: please join on time, mic muted unless speaking, use :hand: emoji to queue for live Qs. We'll also collect written Qs in the thread form. Looking forward to the update.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: All-hands in 15 minutes.

Ethan: On my way, joining from London — good luck to everyone prepping :coffee: 

Grace: Quick prod note for the presentation — I'll include the rollout compatibility matrix (model families by region) — shout if you have compatibility concerns ahead of time.

Maya: Thanks team. See you tomorrow 10:00 PT. Recording & slides posted after the meeting; follow-ups tracked as action items.

(After meeting) Grace: Recording: https://videos.redwood/recordings/1769205678 — Slides: https://drive.redwood/allhands/q2-roadmap.pdf — TL;DR: 1) Dedicated GA targeted in 8 weeks with canary in eu-west-1 then us-west-2; 2) Staging policy: KMS + approval workflow; 3) Incident fix: autoscaler tweak deployed, reducing 95th percentile tail latency; 4) Optimize: pilot showed 27% token-cost reduction with prefix caching.

Maya: Added action items to the tracker: - Customer comms kit (CS) - Dedicated rollout FAQ (Product) - Handbook update (Security) — owners assigned.

Ravi: Thanks for the TL;DR — appreciated. Will catch up on the recording and flag any APAC concerns.

Nora: Posted the incident postmortem link in #postmortems and added the customer-facing note draft to the comms kit folder.

Devon: Shared slides & TL;DR with outreach team.

Maya: Closing note — great meeting, concise Qs, good alignment on next steps. If anything urgent comes up, ping me or Grace directly. :white_check_mark:
